scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build frames.ts messages.ts picture.ts objects.ts program.ts testing.ts --target node --packages external --splitting --chunk-naming 'chunk-[hash].[ext]' --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.release: bun run build && bun pm pack --destination release
scripts.check:release: bun run build && sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d) && bun pm pack --destination "$d" >/dev/null && f=$(basename "$d"/*.tgz) && cmp -s "$d/$f" "release/$f"; r=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $r = 0 ] || { echo "release/$f не совпадает с исходниками — bun run release и закоммить архив" >&2; exit 1; }'
scripts.gate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:bun && bun run test:node && bun run test:deno && bun run check:release
